notes: Identity independently checked: title The Substitutability of Physical and Social Warmth in Daily Life, John A. Bargh and Idit Shalev, DOI 10.1037/a0023527 match the original reference. This is a primary research article text with methods, results, references and appendices, bearing the May 23, 2011 advance-online citation rather than the 2012 issue citation. No PDF was supplied. Supplied page locators for Studies 1a/1b differ from the advance-online printed pagination; study headings establish candidate sections. No replication source or reported-success field is assigned. Printed candidate tests: omnibus F(2, 74)=3.80, p<.05, partial eta-squared printed as ␩2p=.096; cold versus warm t(49)=2.12, p=.04; cold versus neutral t(48)=2.55, p<.01; warm versus neutral t(49)<1 (no same-test p printed for this comparison). Preserve the printed F degrees of freedom without reconciling them to recruitment N. Requested test statistic does not distinguish F from the planned t tests. Recruitment total 75 is not a documented analytic sample for a uniquely selected comparison; no N is inferred from df. All assigned fields examined; null values reflect unresolved target correspondence, not absence of printed results. Unassigned fields are placeholders.
